definitions.explanation: Something that was not anticipated or predicted. A literary/formal expression using the classical negative form せぬ (= しない).

examples.japanese: {予期|よき}せぬ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
{予期|よき}せぬ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{慌|あわ}てた→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧。
examples.english: I was flustered by an unexpected visitor.

examples.japanese: {予期|よき}せぬ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦バックアップ→バックアップ：04870_bakkuappu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧おくべきだ。
examples.english: You should keep backups in preparation for unforeseen trouble.

notes:
USAGE:
{予期|よき}せぬ is a set phrase functioning as a pre-noun modifier. It uses the classical negative form ⟦せぬ→する：00392_suru⟧ (equivalent to ⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ in modern Japanese), giving it a somewhat formal or literary tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Always used before a noun: {予期|よき}せぬ + noun. The modern equivalent ⟦{予期|よき}→予期：03662_yoki⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ is also used but sounds less natural as a fixed expression. The form {予期|よき}せぬ is preferred in writing and formal speech.

FORMS:
- {予期|よき}せぬ (classical negative — standard form)
- ⟦{予期|よき}→予期：03662_yoki⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (modern negative — less common as modifier)
- ⟦{予期|よき}→予期：03662_yoki⟧⟦しなかった→する：00392_suru⟧ (past form — "was unexpected")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予期|よき}せぬ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧ (unforeseen situation)
- {予期|よき}せぬ⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧ (unexpected event)
- {予期|よき}せぬ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (unexpected result)
- {予期|よき}せぬ⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧ (unexpected development)
